title: Escape Helgen
objective: Escape Helgen Keep and reach Skyrim.

title: Reach Riverwood
objective: Travel to Riverwood and speak with your companion's contact.

title: Warn Jarl Balgruuf
objective: Travel to Dragonsreach and warn Jarl Balgruuf about the dragon attack.

title: Speak to Farengar
objective: Speak to Farengar about recovering the Dragonstone.

title: Recover the Dragonstone
objective: Take the Dragonstone from the draugr guarding the word wall.

title: Recover the Golden Claw
objective: Recover the Golden Claw from Arvel the Swift and use it to open the puzzle door.

title: Learn Unrelenting Force — Force
objective: Learn the word of power from the word wall in Bleak Falls Barrow.

title: Deliver the Dragonstone
objective: Return the Dragonstone to Farengar in Dragonsreach.

title: Return the Golden Claw to Lucan
objective: Return the Golden Claw to Lucan Valerius at the Riverwood Trader.

title: Defeat the Dragon at the Western Watchtower
objective: Help Irileth defeat the dragon at the Western Watchtower.

title: Report to Jarl Balgruuf and Become Thane
objective: Return to Jarl Balgruuf after Dragon Rising to report the dragon's defeat and be named Thane.

title: Purchase Breezehome
objective: Purchase Breezehome from the Whiterun steward for 5,000 gold.

title: Answer the Greybeards and Learn Ro
objective: Climb to High Hrothgar, demonstrate the Voice, and receive the second word of Unrelenting Force.

title: Learn Whirlwind Sprint
objective: Complete the Greybeards' trial and receive the first word of Whirlwind Sprint.

title: Search Ustengrav for the Horn
objective: Travel through Ustengrav and reach the resting place of the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller.

title: Learn a word of Become Ethereal at Ustengrav
objective: Learn the next unacquired word of Become Ethereal from Ustengrav's word wall.

title: Meet the Horn's Taker
objective: Meet Delphine in the secret room at the Sleeping Giant Inn and recover the Horn.

title: Return the Horn and Receive Dah
objective: Return the Horn to Arngeir, receive formal recognition, and learn the final word of Unrelenting Force.

title: Defeat Sahloknir with Delphine
objective: Travel with Delphine to Kynesgrove, defeat the resurrected dragon, and speak with her afterward.

title: Plan the Embassy Infiltration
objective: Meet Delphine at the Sleeping Giant Inn and agree to infiltrate the Thalmor Embassy.

title: Give Equipment to Malborn
objective: Meet Malborn at the Winking Skeever and choose equipment to smuggle into the embassy.

title: Meet Delphine and Depart for the Embassy
objective: Meet Delphine near Katla's Farm, change into party clothes, and take the carriage to the embassy.

title: Recover the Thalmor Intelligence
objective: Infiltrate the Thalmor Embassy and recover the dossiers identifying Esbern.
warning_text: Full embassy access is quest-gated; finish the intelligence search before escaping.

title: Escape the Embassy
objective: Escape the embassy through Reeking Cave with the recovered intelligence.

title: Find Esbern in the Ratway
objective: Search the Ratway Warrens and convince Esbern to leave his hideout.

title: Bring Esbern to Delphine
objective: Escort Esbern to Delphine at the Sleeping Giant Inn.

title: Reach Sky Haven Temple through Karthspire
objective: Travel with Esbern and Delphine through Karthspire and reach the temple entrance.

title: Open Sky Haven Temple and Study Alduin's Wall
objective: Open Sky Haven Temple and learn how the ancient Blades defeated Alduin.

title: Receive Clear Skies
objective: Ask Arngeir for access to Paarthurnax and learn all three words of Clear Skies.

title: Meet Paarthurnax and Learn Fire Breath
objective: Use Clear Skies to reach Paarthurnax and receive a word of Fire Breath.

title: Consult Septimus Signus
objective: Obtain the Attunement Sphere and Blank Lexicon needed to reach the Elder Scroll.

title: Descend through Alftand
objective: Traverse Alftand and use the Attunement Sphere to open the route into Blackreach.

title: Cross Blackreach to the Tower of Mzark
objective: Navigate Blackreach and reach the Tower of Mzark.

title: Acquire the Elder Scroll (Dragon)
objective: Operate the Tower of Mzark mechanism and take the Dragon Elder Scroll.

title: Learn Dragonrend from the Elder Scroll
objective: Read the Elder Scroll at the Time-Wound and learn Dragonrend from the ancient heroes.

title: Drive Alduin from the Throat of the World
objective: Use Dragonrend to defeat Alduin and force him to retreat.

title: Gain Admission to the College
objective: Pass Faralda's admission requirement and enter the College of Winterhold.

title: Complete Tolfdir's First Lesson
objective: Attend Tolfdir's lesson and demonstrate a ward spell.

title: Explore Saarthal with Tolfdir
objective: Explore Saarthal and discover the Eye of Magnus.

title: Recover the Stolen Books
objective: Recover the stolen books from Fellglow Keep.

title: Consult the Augur of Dunlain
objective: Report to the Arch-Mage and consult the Augur of Dunlain at the College.

title: Find the Staff of Magnus Lead
objective: Explore Mzulft and use the Oculory to locate the Staff of Magnus.

title: Report the Mzulft Discovery
objective: Return to the College of Winterhold after locating the Staff of Magnus.

title: Defend Winterhold
objective: Defeat the magical anomalies attacking Winterhold.

title: Report After Defending Winterhold
objective: Return to the College after defeating the magical anomalies.

title: Recover the Staff of Magnus
objective: Enter Labyrinthian, defeat Morokei, and recover the Staff of Magnus.

title: Obtain the Morokei Mask
objective: Loot the Morokei dragon priest mask while recovering the Staff of Magnus.

title: SET ASIDE — 10 Fire Salts
objective: Keep 10 Fire Salts for Balimund in Riften; do not sell or consume them.

title: Ask Balimund About His Forge
objective: Speak to Balimund about the fire salts needed for his forge.

title: Deliver 10 Fire Salts to Balimund
objective: Bring all 10 Fire Salts to Balimund at The Scorched Hammer.

prerequisites.description: Set aside all 10 Fire Salts before planning the delivery.

title: Speak to Aventus Aretino
objective: Speak to Aventus Aretino about Grelod the Kind.

title: Kill Grelod the Kind
objective: Kill Grelod the Kind at Honorhall Orphanage.

title: Report Back to Aventus Aretino
objective: Return to Aventus Aretino after killing Grelod.

title: Sleep After Completing Innocence Lost
objective: Sleep in a bed after completing Innocence Lost to trigger the Dark Brotherhood encounter.

title: Join the Dark Brotherhood
objective: Obey Astrid in the Abandoned Shack to continue With Friends Like These...

title: Kill Astrid
objective: Kill Astrid in the Abandoned Shack to begin Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!

title: Learn the Trapping Plan from Paarthurnax
objective: Ask Paarthurnax how to locate and capture one of Alduin's allies.

title: Learn the Trapping Plan from Arngeir
objective: Ask Arngeir how to locate and capture one of Alduin's allies.

title: Learn the Trapping Plan from Esbern
objective: Ask Esbern how to locate and capture one of Alduin's allies.

title: Ask the Jarl to Use Dragonsreach
objective: Ask the Jarl for permission to trap a dragon, then record whether Skyrim required a truce.

outcome_options.truce_bypassed: Truce bypassed by Civil War state

title: Ask Arngeir to Host the Peace Council
objective: Ask Arngeir to host negotiations at High Hrothgar.

title: Convince General Tullius to Attend
objective: Deliver the Greybeards' summons to General Tullius at Castle Dour.

title: Convince Ulfric Stormcloak to Attend
objective: Deliver the Greybeards' summons to Ulfric at the Palace of the Kings.

title: Negotiate the Truce
objective: Return to High Hrothgar and negotiate a temporary Civil War truce.

title: Capture and Interrogate Odahviing
objective: Prepare the trap, call Odahviing, capture him, and learn how to reach Skuldafn.

title: Kill Paarthurnax
objective: If you accept the Blades' demand, kill Paarthurnax at the Throat of the World.

title: Report Paarthurnax's Death to the Blades
objective: Return to Sky Haven Temple and report Paarthurnax's death.

title: Release Odahviing and Depart for Skuldafn
objective: Release Odahviing at Dragonsreach and have him carry you to Skuldafn.
warning_text: Departure begins a one-way expedition. Finish preparations before releasing Odahviing.

title: Acquire the Diamond Claw
objective: Loot the Diamond Claw from its draugr guardian in Skuldafn Temple.
warning_text: Skuldafn cannot be revisited normally after entering Sovngarde.

title: Use the Diamond Claw
objective: Use the Diamond Claw to open the puzzle door and progress through Skuldafn Temple.

title: Defeat Nahkriin
objective: Defeat the dragon priest guarding Alduin's portal.

title: Obtain the Nahkriin Mask
objective: Loot Nahkriin's unique dragon priest mask before leaving Skuldafn.
warning_text: Nahkriin cannot be revisited after leaving Skuldafn normally.

title: Open the Portal to Sovngarde
objective: Use Nahkriin's staff at the dragon seal to open Alduin's portal.
warning_text: Do not enter until every remaining Skuldafn objective is complete.

title: Enter Sovngarde
objective: Enter Alduin's portal after completing every Skuldafn objective you intend to collect.
warning_text: Entering permanently ends normal access to Skuldafn.

title: Reach the Hall of Valor and Rally the Heroes
objective: Cross Sovngarde, prove yourself to Tsun, and enlist the ancient heroes against Alduin.

title: Defeat Alduin in Sovngarde
objective: Dispel Alduin's mist with the heroes and defeat the World-Eater.

title: Receive Call of Valor and Return to Skyrim
objective: Receive the Call of Valor shout from Tsun before returning to the Throat of the World.

title: Learn a word of Storm Call at Skuldafn
objective: Learn the next unacquired word of Storm Call from Skuldafn's word wall.
warning_text: The Skuldafn word wall cannot be revisited normally after departure.

title: Find Meridia's Beacon
